card.line: Samaria was the hill Omri bought and built into the capital of the northern kingdom of Israel, a region ruled by evil kings that finally fell to Assyria.

moments.title: Omri builds Samaria
moments.text: Omri paid Shemer two talents of silver for the hill of Samaria and built a city on it. He named the city after Shemer, who had owned the hill.

moments.title: Ahab's temple of Baal
moments.text: Ahab became king and reigned in Samaria twenty-two years. He married Jezebel and built a temple for Baal in Samaria, where he set up an altar for Baal.

moments.title: Blind soldiers led to Samaria
moments.text: Elisha prayed and the LORD struck the Aramean soldiers with blindness. Elisha led them into the city of Samaria, where the LORD opened their eyes, and the king fed them and sent them home.

moments.title: Famine under siege
moments.text: Ben-hadad of Aram surrounded the city of Samaria with his army, and a terrible famine followed. Food became so costly that a donkey's head sold for eighty shekels of silver.

moments.title: Assyria captures Samaria
moments.text: Assyria's king besieged the city of Samaria for three years and then captured it. He carried the Israelites away to Assyria because they had sinned against the LORD.
